findings.summary: Pager commands are implemented as href-less anchors with button roles.
findings.consequence: The controls are focusable and have explicit Enter/Space handlers, but they still reimplement native button behavior and miss the simpler semantic element expected for command actions.
findings.evidence: Line 1766 renders `Gå till första träffen` as `<a role="button" tabindex="0" ...>`; the same pattern is repeated for the last-page, goto-page, and author-facet commands in the owned template range.
findings.recommendation: Use `<button type="button">` for these command actions and keep the existing labels, `aria-pressed` states, and click handlers. This preserves behavior while relying on native keyboard and button semantics.
